journeys.title: Western Sichuan Private Road Trip
journeys.subtitle: Where the Road Meets Tibetan Culture.
journeys.body: Follow the road west from Chengdu into the highlands of western Sichuan. Cross dramatic mountain valleys, open grasslands and Jiarong Tibetan villages, then discover Kham Tibetan traditions around Tagong and Kangding.
journeys.seoDescription: Follow the road west from Chengdu into the highlands of western Sichuan. Cross dramatic mountain valleys, open grasslands and Jiarong Tibetan villages, then discover Kham Tibetan traditions around Tagong and Kangding.

hero.alt: Western Sichuan Private Road Trip — AI illustration
hero.caption: Western Sichuan Private Road Trip — AI illustration

intro.title: The Road Is Part of the Discovery.
paragraphs: Leave the city behind and follow the road into a different world. From the mountain valleys around Siguniang to the stone-built Jiarong Tibetan villages of Zhonglu and the open grasslands of Tagong, every stretch reveals a new landscape and a different side of local life.
A possible route can connect Wolong, Shuangqiao Valley, Zhonglu, Tagong and Kangding — bringing spectacular scenery together with meaningful cultural encounters.
This is just one way to explore Western Sichuan. With its many valleys, grasslands and cultural regions, the journey can be shaped around your interests, travel time and preferred pace.
regionCues: Western Sichuan · Jiarong and Kham Tibetan cultural areas

experience.body: The best part of a road trip is not simply where you arrive, but everything you discover along the way.

story.title: More Than Just a Road Trip.
paragraphs: A road trip is about having the freedom to experience a place, not simply passing through it.
Pause when a valley opens up. Spend more time in a traditional village. Take in the changing light across the grasslands, or discover a place you never expected to find.
With a private vehicle and a thoughtfully planned route, you can travel at your own pace, explore beyond the usual stops and experience the landscapes and cultures of Western Sichuan more closely.
Because sometimes, the most memorable moments happen between destinations.

journeys.title: Deep Cultural Journey
journeys.eyebrow: A DEEPER WAY TO DISCOVER CHINESE CULTURE
journeys.subtitle: Discover China's Cultural Depth Through Sichuan.
journeys.body: From the ancient Shu civilization and the legacy of Shu-Han to Daoist philosophy, Buddhist heritage and the living traditions of western Sichuan, explore the many cultural layers that make this region a remarkable window into China.
journeys.seoDescription: From the ancient Shu civilization and the legacy of Shu-Han to Daoist philosophy, Buddhist heritage and the living traditions of western Sichuan, explore the many cultural layers that make this region a remarkable window into China.

intro.title: One Region. Many Cultural Worlds.
paragraphs: Sichuan is more than a destination. It is a meeting ground of histories, beliefs and living traditions.
The Chengdu Plain preserves the legacy of ancient Shu and Shu-Han, while Mount Qingcheng, Mount Emei and Leshan reveal the region’s profound Daoist and Buddhist heritage.
Beyond the basin, Tibetan and Qiang communities bring other cultural landscapes into view.
Together, these traditions offer a deeper way to understand southwest China — not through landmarks alone, but through the stories, ideas and practices that give them meaning.

experience.title: Explore the Cultural Layers of Sichuan
experience.body: Discover the civilizations, philosophies and traditions that have shaped this remarkable region.

items.title: Ancient Shu Civilization
items.body: Explore Sanxingdui and the archaeological story of Jinsha. Bronze masks, ritual objects and other treasures reveal a distinctive civilization that flourished in the Sichuan Basin thousands of years ago.

items.title: Shu-Han & Three Kingdoms Legacy
items.body: Explore Chengdu’s Wuhou Shrine and the stories of Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang. Discover the history of Shu-Han and its lasting place in China’s Three Kingdoms heritage.

items.body: Walk through forested mountain paths and ancient temples at Mount Qingcheng, closely connected to the origins of Daoism. Explore a tradition shaped by reflection, cultivation and the relationship between humanity and nature.

story.title: Understand the Culture, Not Just the Place.
paragraphs: Visiting a temple or historic site is only the beginning.
With thoughtful interpretation and local knowledge, these places become more than beautiful backdrops. They reveal the ideas, beliefs, craftsmanship and everyday lives that have shaped the region.
We create room for meaningful cultural encounters, helping you connect the past with the present and discover the stories behind what you see.

goodToKnow.title: Best Time to Travel
goodToKnow.body: We recommend the best timing based on the regions, cultural sites and experiences you want to explore. Seasonal conditions and local schedules may influence the final itinerary.

goodToKnow.title: Travel Between Regions
goodToKnow.body: Cultural highlights are spread across the Sichuan Basin and surrounding highlands. We carefully plan routes and travel times to connect different destinations without making the journey feel rushed.

goodToKnow.title: Access & Activities
goodToKnow.body: Site access, cultural visits and hands-on activities depend on local opening hours, availability and permission. We coordinate arrangements in advance and respect local customs and traditions.

goodToKnow.title: Tailor-Made
goodToKnow.body: Your journey is shaped around your interests, travel dates and preferred pace. From cultural themes to destinations and experiences, we work with you to create a journey that feels personal and meaningful.
